setup.zh: 出秘境后的第二夜，柴房里。你从柴垛最底下掏出饭桶，把秘境里带出来的东西摆在柴墩上：一撮鼎苔，一根龙须草，一粒息珠。
setup.en: The second night out of the hidden realm, in the woodshed. You dig the Rice Bucket out from under the woodpile and lay out on the chopping block what you brought out of the realm: a pinch of cauldron moss, a stalk of dragon-whisker grass, a breath pearl.

recap.zh: 秘境里拿命换出来的鼎苔、龙须草、息珠，连一袋子灵石，全喂了饭桶——它只打了个嗝。你气得扔进去一根萝卜：「咔哒」，一颗九转筑基丹，拿油纸裹了三层，藏了起来。
recap.en: The cauldron moss, the dragon-whisker grass and the breath pearl you bought with your life, and a pouchful of spirit stones, all went into the Rice Bucket — it only burped. In a temper you threw in a radish: *click*, a nine-turn Foundation Pill, wrapped in three layers of oiled paper and hidden away.

zh: 出秘境后的第二夜，柴房。
「喂进饭桶，兴许开出一颗筑基丹来。」
en: The second night out of the realm, the woodshed.
"Fed into the Rice Bucket, they might come out as a Foundation Pill."

story.zh: 过了两夜，他从柴垛最底下把饭桶掏了出来，把秘境里带出来的东西摆在柴墩上：一撮鼎苔，一根龙须草，一粒息珠。息珠攥在手心里，像攥着一颗心。这三样，他是拿命换出来的；喂进饭桶，兴许开出一颗筑基丹来。
story.en: Two nights later he dug the Rice Bucket out from the very bottom of the woodpile and laid out on the chopping block what he'd brought out of the secret realm: a pinch of cauldron moss, a stalk of dragon-whisker grass, a breath pearl. He held the breath pearl in his palm like holding a heart. These three things he'd traded his life for. Fed into the Rice Bucket, they might come out as a Foundation Pill.

story_full.zh: 过了两夜，他从柴垛最底下把饭桶掏了出来，把秘境里带出来的东西摆在柴墩上：一撮鼎苔，一根龙须草，一粒息珠。拳头大那一团，他只捏出这一撮，余下的包好，收回储物袋里，留着筑基那天自己吃，生吃也多一分把握。息珠攥在手心里，像攥着一颗心。这三样，他是拿命换出来的；喂进饭桶，兴许开出一颗筑基丹来。
story_full.en: Two nights later he dug the Rice Bucket out from the very bottom of the woodpile and laid out on the chopping block what he'd brought out of the secret realm: a pinch of cauldron moss, a stalk of dragon-whisker grass, a breath pearl. Of the fist-sized ball of moss he pinched off only this much; the rest he wrapped and put back in the storage pouch, to eat himself on the day he established his foundation; even eaten raw it would add a little to his chances. He held the breath pearl in his palm like holding a heart. These three things he'd traded his life for. Fed into the Rice Bucket, they might come out as a Foundation Pill.

story_after.zh:
他把鼎苔、龙须草、那粒息珠，连那一袋子灵石，「哗啦啦」一股脑倒了进去。肚里「咯嘣咯嘣」，嚼得山响；嚼完了，打了个饱嗝，没了动静。里头空空的，连一张破符也没有。

他往包袱里一摸，摸出来的是一根萝卜。他攥着那根萝卜，越看越气，抬手往饭桶里一扔：「吃！你吃！」「咔哒」。

肚里躺着一颗丹，透亮得像一滴凝住的露水，丹身上九道纹，金灿灿的。他揉揉眼睛，再数，九道；再揉，再数，还是九道。

「那这一颗，是怎么来的？」「……萝卜。」银月凑过去，闻了一闻，声音都变了：「九转……筑基丹。」小满道：「筑基丹？大比冠军一年才赏一颗的那个？」「那个是一转。这个，是九转。」她扭过头去，狠狠瞪着柴垛底下那只饭桶，嘴角一抽，又一抽——她那颗九转还魂丹，换回来的是一颗聚气丹。
story_after.en:
He tipped in the cauldron moss, the dragon-whisker grass, the breath pearl, and with them the whole pouchful of spirit stones, all in one clattering rush. Inside it went *crunch, crunch*, chewing loud enough to shake the mountain; when it had finished chewing it gave a full belch, and went quiet. It was empty inside, not even a torn talisman.

He felt in his bundle, and what came out was a radish. He gripped the radish, and the more he looked at it the angrier he got, and he threw it into the Rice Bucket: "Eat! Go on, eat!" *Click.*

In the belly lay a pill, clear as a drop of dew set solid, with nine lines on it, gleaming gold. He rubbed his eyes and counted again: nine lines. Rubbed again, counted again: still nine.

"Then this one, where did it come from?" "...A radish." Yinyue leaned in and sniffed it, and her voice changed altogether: "A Nine-Turn... Foundation Pill." Xiaoman said: "A Foundation Pill? The kind the contest champion only gets one of a year?" "That kind is one-turn. This is nine-turn." Her own Nine-Turn Soul-Return Pill had got back a Qi-Gathering Pill.

story_after_full.zh:
他把鼎苔、龙须草、那粒息珠，连那一袋子灵石、那颗中品、怀里那块暗了一层的，「哗啦啦」一股脑倒了进去。想出仙品，得喂仙品。两只手按上铜肚子，送得眼前发花。肚里「咯嘣咯嘣」，嚼得山响；嚼完了，打了个饱嗝，没了动静。他等了一炷香，掀开盖子，里头空空的，连一张破符也没有。

小满蹲在那里，看着那只空肚子。他想起凶崖底下那一线水声，想起那面盾顶着他喉咙的时候眼前一点一点黑下去，想起崖上那一声长长的惨叫。他是拿这些换的；连那一袋子灵石，一块不剩，也搭进去了。那个饱嗝，还在他耳朵里。他往包袱里一摸，摸出来的是一根萝卜——前一天从伙房讨的，留着夜里啃。他攥着那根萝卜，越看越气，抬手往饭桶里一扔：「吃！你吃！」

「咔哒」。

盖子一开，一股清凉的香气扑出来，像雨后的松林，小狰的鼻子先动了。肚里躺着一颗丹，透亮得像一滴凝住的露水，丹身上九道纹，金灿灿的；纹以外光溜溜的，一个字也没有——不像饭桶从前吐的那些零碎，罐上、纸角上、肚皮底下，个个自报家门。小满伸着脖子瞧了一眼，两只眼睛登时瞪成了两个铜钱，下巴「咔」地掉了下来，张着嘴，半天合不上；他揉揉眼睛，再数，九道；再揉，再数，还是九道。

他把那颗丹拿油纸裹了三层，收进储物袋里。这颗丹要是漏出去半句，他这条小命不算，银月、饭桶，都要给人一锅端了。

第二天一早，银月才钻了出来。他把油纸包摊开给她看。她看看那颗丹，又看看他腰上那只瘪了的储物袋。小满道：「全喂了。它就打了个嗝。」「那这一颗，是怎么来的？」「……萝卜。」银月半天没说话。她凑过去，闻了一闻，又闻了一闻，声音都变了：「九转……筑基丹。」小满道：「筑基丹？大比冠军一年才赏一颗的那个？」「那个是一转。」她道，「这个，是九转。」一双金眼睛越瞪越圆，尾巴上的毛「蓬」地一下全炸开了，炸成一把鸡毛掸子；她扭过头去，狠狠瞪着柴垛底下那只饭桶，嘴角一抽，又一抽——她那颗九转还魂丹，换回来的是一颗聚气丹。
story_after_full.en:
He tipped in the cauldron moss, the dragon-whisker grass, the breath pearl, and with them the whole pouchful of spirit stones, the middle-grade one, and the one in his robe that had dimmed a layer, all in one clattering rush. If you want an immortal-grade thing out, you have to feed it immortal-grade things. He pressed both hands to the copper belly and fed it power until his eyes swam. Inside it went *crunch, crunch*, chewing loud enough to shake the mountain; when it had finished chewing it gave a full belch, and went quiet. He waited the length of an incense stick and lifted the lid. It was empty inside, not even a torn talisman.

Xiaoman crouched there, looking at that empty belly. He thought of the thread of dripping water at the foot of the Deadly Cliff, of the shield against his throat and everything going black a little at a time, of that long scream on the cliff. That was what he'd traded for these; and the whole pouchful of spirit stones too, every last one, thrown in. That belch was still in his ears. He felt in his bundle, and what came out was a radish, begged from the kitchen the day before, kept to chew at night. He gripped the radish, and the more he looked at it the angrier he got, and he threw it into the Rice Bucket: "Eat! Go on, eat!"

*Click.*

The lid opened, and a cool fragrance came out, like a pine wood after rain; the little zheng's nose moved first. In the belly lay a pill, clear as a drop of dew set solid, with nine lines on it, gleaming gold. Beyond the lines it was smooth, not a word on it: not like the bits and pieces the Rice Bucket had spat out before, which all announced themselves, on the jar, on the corner of the paper, on the underside. Xiaoman craned his neck and looked, and his eyes went round as two copper coins and his jaw dropped with a *click*, and his mouth hung open a long while. He rubbed his eyes and counted again: nine lines. Rubbed again, counted again: still nine.

He wrapped the pill in three layers of oiled paper and put it in the storage pouch. If half a word about this pill got out, never mind his own little life, Yinyue and the Rice Bucket would be scooped up in one pot along with him.

Only the next morning did Yinyue come out. He unwrapped the oiled-paper packet to show her. She looked at the pill, then at the flat storage pouch at his waist. Xiaoman said: "I fed it everything. It just belched." "Then this one, where did it come from?" "...A radish." For a long while Yinyue said nothing. She leaned in and sniffed it, sniffed it again, and her voice changed altogether: "A Nine-Turn... Foundation Pill." Xiaoman said: "A Foundation Pill? The kind the contest champion only gets one of a year?" "That kind is one-turn," she said. "This is nine-turn." Her golden eyes got rounder and rounder, and the fur on her tail exploded with a *whumph* into a feather duster. She twisted round and glared hard at the Rice Bucket at the foot of the woodpile, the corner of her mouth twitching, twitching. Her own Nine-Turn Soul-Return Pill had got back a Qi-Gathering Pill.

_beats: 2026-10-20 (Hanli: 「剧情连续阅读太长的地方, 你处理一下, 看是否可以加个小游戏等」; the standing rule of 10-19): wm-kaikai → 讲堂 read 3,811 字 without play. The feeding of the 秘境's spoils is the book's own action — 「喂进饭桶，兴许开出一颗筑基丹来」 — and feeding the 饭桶 is already 割绳子's daily frame, so 喂饭桶 · 那粒息珠 (xizhurope, a 割绳子 level) plays it; the burp, the empty belly, the radish and the pill are read after it (`story_after`). The passage was wm-chu's way on (`rest`), from 「过了两夜」 on, cut and book alike; this scene is its own place (the woodshed), outside the 秘境.

label.en: Wrap the pill and put it away

exits.means: wraps the nine-turn Foundation pill in three layers of oiled paper and hides it; trains through the month to the contest's eve

story.zh: 那以后的夜里，他练功不为账，也不为藏。瞿老头也不抬，只把扫帚往旁边让了一让：「步子轻了。」
story.en: On the nights after that, he trained neither for the books nor to hide. Without lifting his head, Elder Qu just moved the broom aside a little: "Your step's gone light."

story_full.zh:
那天夜里，他从伙房又讨了一根萝卜，喂了进去，搓着手等。「噗」的一声，炉口喷出一股黑烟，正喷在他脸上，盖子「咔哒」一合，再按，按不开了。小满顶着一张黑脸，只剩两只眼白一眨一眨，嘴一张，又吐出一小口黑烟来。小狰在一旁看着他，打了一个响鼻，一头栽进柴堆里，四脚朝天地打滚。他道：「……这桶，是不是在生气？」一连三夜，他蹲在跟前赔着笑脸，好话说了一箩筐，那盖子都没给他开。

那以后的夜里，他练功不为账，也不为藏。他在柴房后头拉那张弓，拉满，松开，再拉满。拉完了，拿那把缺了三个牙的短刀，对着一根木桩，一刀一刀地练他爹放鹿血的那一下。练完了，坐下来吐纳，一口一口，把水缸往满里灌，灌到半满，自己停下来。

有一天挑水路过山门，瞿老在山门台阶上扫地。小满站住了，看那把扫帚。瞿老头也不抬，只把扫帚往旁边让了一让：「步子轻了。」

腊月初七，离冬月初一周衡在执事房门口说的那个日子，只剩一天了。明日腊八，宗门大比，内门外门一起比，五行台。冠军，筑基丹一枚——全观一年，就这一颗。
story_full.en:
That night he begged another radish from the kitchen, fed it in, and waited rubbing his hands. With a *pfff* the mouth of the furnace shot out a puff of black smoke right into his face, and the lid snapped shut, *click*; he pressed, and it wouldn't open. Xiaoman sat there with a black face, only the whites of his eyes blinking, and when he opened his mouth he breathed out a little puff of black smoke. The little zheng watched him, snorted, pitched headfirst into the woodpile, and rolled about with its feet in the air. He said: "...Is this bucket sulking?" Three nights running he crouched in front of it with an apologetic smile and said a basketful of nice things, and the lid wouldn't open for him.

On the nights after that, he trained neither for the books nor to hide. He drew the bow behind the woodshed: draw full, release, draw full again. When he'd done that, he took the short knife with three teeth gone and practised, cut after cut on a wooden post, that one stroke of his father's for bleeding a deer. When he'd done that, he sat down to breathe out and in, a breath at a time, filling the water vat towards full, and when it was half full, he stopped of his own accord.

One day, carrying water past the mountain gate, he found Elder Qu sweeping the steps. Xiaoman stopped and watched the broom. Without lifting his head, Elder Qu just moved the broom aside a little: "Your step's gone light."

The seventh of the twelfth month: one day left before the date Zhou Heng named at the stewards' office door on the first of the eleventh. Tomorrow, Laba, the sect contest, inner court and outer court together, on the Five Elements Platform. Champion, one Foundation pill — one a year, for the whole temple.

refuse.zh: 息珠还在柴墩上——喂进饭桶去。
refuse.en: The breath pearl is still on the chopping block — feed it to the Rice Bucket.
